title: Hidden-test shadow runner
pitch: A plugin that treats the issue body's implied tests as a contract and refuses to finish until a local shadow suite is green. Not the official hidden tests — a reconstructed public proxy.

title: One-page repo map
pitch: On session start, write a 30-line map: package layout, test runner, how to run one test. Inject it every turn. Cheap models waste the first 10 calls discovering pytest vs django.

title: Patch diff budget
pitch: Hard-cap the working tree diff at 120 lines. If exceeded, the plugin rewinds the extra hunks and asks for a smaller fix. Lite gold patches are tiny.
